content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may send their updated Resume/CV along with educational qualification and experience details to the official email address or submit them physically. Email Address: [email protected] Email Subject Line: Application for Technical Assistant – District Climate Change Mission, Kallakurichi Postal/In-person Submission Address: District Collector Office, Kallakurichi / District Climate Change Mission, District Collector office, Kallakurichi

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates should possess an Undergraduate Degree in any of the following fields: Life Sciences Environmental Sciences Ecology Forestry Wildlife Public Policy Similar / allied fields Additionally, candidates must possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English. Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience will be given priority. Candidates having 1 year of relevant experience, preferably in a Government Department / Government Office, are preferred. Additional desired skills include: Experience in Data Entry and Data Management Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping and documentation Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint Ability to prepare official reports, letters, statements and PowerPoint presentations Experience in data compilation, tabulation and office documentation Good communication, coordination and organisational skills Ability to coordinate with Government Departments and stakeholders Residency: The candidate must be a resident of Kallakurichi District. Age Limit: The candidate should not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Kallakurichi Technical Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The key responsibilities associated with the Technical Assistant position include: Coordinate DCCM activities with Government Departments and stakeholders. Assist in implementation and monitoring of climate change and environmental activities. Organise and support capacity-building programmes. Collect, compile and maintain climate and environmental data. Prepare reports, official correspondence, statements, presentations and documentation. Maintain official files, records and Mission-related documents. Assist in conducting DCCM meetings, workshops, training and awareness programmes. Document successful climate initiatives and district-level best practices. Undertake field visits related to District Climate Change Mission activities. Perform any other duties assigned by the Mission Director / District Climate Officer.

content_sections.text: The selection process for the Technical Assistant post will include: Scrutiny of Applications In-person Interview Typing Test A waiting list of 2–3 candidates may also be maintained as per the DCCM guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. What is the position offered under DCCM Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The position offered is Technical Assistant under the District Climate Change Mission, Kallakurichi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the consolidated monthly salary for the Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of ₹22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy, or similar/allied fields, along with basic typing skills in Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates should not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post.

faq.question: Q7. Are candidates required to be local residents?
faq.answer: Yes, the candidate must be a resident of Kallakurichi District.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can send their updated Resume/CV with educational and experience details to [email protected] or submit them directly at the District Collector Office, Kallakurichi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications, an in-person interview, and a typing test.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration and nature of the engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contract basis for a period of 19 months, as per Government sanction.
